title: Going deeper: Feedback stays with the work
categoryContext: Growing independence at home, school and online
stageSummary: Describe events, effort and impact without turning a moment into a permanent judgement.
possibleWeather: Older children may hear pressure as mistrust, public judgement or loss of agency. Make the reason, choice and responsibility visible.
practice: describe the work privately and identify a starting point
principle: Keep feedback specific, dignified and connected to the task.
nextSentence: The work still needs correction. Tell me what is getting in the way, then we can describe the work privately and identify a starting point.
keyLearning: Keep feedback specific, dignified and connected to the task.
